verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official MCP integration that lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP-compatible client connect to Windmill and trigger its scripts and flows as tools, and the probe confirms an official MCP server doc page. Evidence is limited to one summary sentence plus the probe. Missing for 10: details on selecting or scoping which workflows are exposed as tools, auth/token setup for the MCP endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call

citations.quote: With MCP, you can connect your favorite LLMs (like Claude, Cursor, or any MCP compatible client) to Windmill, allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat.
